mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM natural_exposure_schema_history WHERE version=#{version}
SELECT FROM natural_impression_outbox WHERE status='READY' AND available_at IS NOT NULL AND last_error IS NULL LIMIT 0

WITH due AS (SELECT event_id FROM natural_impression_outbox WHERE status IN ('READY','SENDING') AND available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE natural_impression_outbox o SET status='SENDING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1, available_at=clock_timestamp()+(#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second') FROM due WHERE o.event_id=due.event_id RETURNING o.event_id,o.event_type,o.schema_version, o.destination,o.partition_key,o.payload_json,o.fence,o.attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE natural_impression_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='SENDING' AND available_at > clock_timestamp()

WITH due AS (SELECT event_id FROM natural_impression_outbox WHERE status IN ('READY','SENDING') AND available_at <= clock_timestamp() AND attempts=#{maxAttempts} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE natural_impression_outbox o SET status='DEAD',last_error='ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED' FROM due WHERE o.event_id=due.event_id
mapper.select: SELECT status,fence,attempts FROM natural_impression_outbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO natural_impression_outbox_replay(replay_id,event_id,actor,reason,old_attempts,previous_fence,new_fence) VALUES(#{replayId},#{eventId},#{actor},#{reason},#{attempts},#{fence},#{fence}+1) ON CONFLICT(replay_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE natural_impression_outbox SET status='READY',attempts=0,fence=fence+1,available_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('READY','SENDING')) AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='DEAD') AS dead, coalesce(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('READY','SENDING'))),0) AS oldest_seconds FROM natural_impression_outbox WHERE status <> 'PUBLISHED'
